title: Behind the Grandstand
about: A hidden moment at the fair where two people wanted different kinds of closeness without realizing it.
description: This track looks back on a quiet night behind the grandstand that became an early turning point in a relationship. I kept pulling away whenever someone approached because I wanted to protect our privacy, while she wanted an uninterrupted moment together. Neither intention was wrong, but we never explained what we were feeling. In hindsight, the repeated pauses became one of the first signs that we were beginning to drift apart without either of us understanding why.

Lyrics: Verse 1
We'd found another place the crowds passed by,
Hidden on a hillside beneath the summer sky.
Behind the grandstand, tucked behind a tree,
It felt like the whole fair disappeared for you and me.
The lights were distant, the music played on,
For a little while the outside world was gone.
We thought we'd found a place no one would know...
A little piece of quiet where our love could grow.
Pre-Chorus
Then footsteps echoed through the night...
Chorus
Behind the grandstand, we kept stopping and starting,
Waiting for strangers to keep on walking.
I was trying to keep us out of sight,
You were trying to hold on to the night.
Somewhere between caution and your heart,
We began drifting worlds apart.
Neither of us knew it then...
Something was changing behind the grandstand.
Verse 2
Every time someone wandered just a little too near,
I'd pull away until the path was clear.
Then we'd pick up right where we'd been before,
Only to hear another voice once more.
I wasn't trying to leave your side,
I was only trying to give us somewhere to hide.
I thought protecting us was what I should do...
I never knew it felt different to you.
Pre-Chorus
The silence grew between each pause...
Chorus
Behind the grandstand, we kept stopping and starting,
Waiting for strangers to keep on walking.
I was watching every passing light,
You were wishing I'd just hold you tight.
Standing inches from the one I loved,
Somehow still not close enough.
Neither of us meant to let it bend...
It started breaking behind the grandstand.
Bridge
Looking back, I don't think either of us was wrong.
You wanted one uninterrupted moment.
I wanted to make sure we weren't discovered.
We were fighting different battles
Without ever saying a word.
Love doesn't always fall apart with shouting...
Sometimes it slips away
Between the pauses.
Final Chorus
Behind the grandstand, the night kept moving on,
The laughter echoed while the feeling slowly dawned.
I thought I was protecting what we had,
Never seeing it was making you sad.
One hillside hidden from the crowd,
One lesson learned without a sound.
The ending didn't start with goodbye...
It started there, behind the grandstand.
